speaker: Wayward Chocobo
line_text: Kweh! Kweh! (This chocobo seems to have been separated from its friends. It looks lonely.) Ride the chocobo? (choices: Giddyap! / No, thanks.) / Kweh! Kweh! (The chocobo looks a mite peckish. Feed it some gysahl greens and it may let you ride it.) Feed the chocobo gysahl greens? (choices: Yes / No) / Kweh! Kweh! (The chocobo looks a mite peckish. Feed it some gysahl greens and it may let you ride it.) Kweh!? Kwehhh! (The chocobo doesn't smell any greens on you and clearly wants to be left alone.) / K-Kweh!? Kwehhh! (The chocobo trembles in fear at the sight of the Esper.) Kweh—kweh, kweh... (The chocobo looks like it would let you ride if you dismissed the Esper first.) / K—kweh!? Kwehhh! (The chocobo trembles in fear at the sight of the Esper.) Kweh—kweh, kweh... (The chocobo clearly wants you to dismiss the Esper and give it some gysahl greens.)

speaker: Vaan
line_text: I guess this one was a success! / - Wow, I'm impressed, Vaan. - I got a good feeling!

An alliance between Dalmasca and the Empire? / Reason tells me 'tis the only course. We must avoid a wasting war with the Empire at all cost. / Yet I fear I could not bear the shame. Had I but the strength— / A shame perhaps for me and for you. But for Dalmasca it is hope!

speaker: Ashe
line_text: And you can just accept this, can you?

speaker: Basch
line_text: After Vayne's ruse I had abandoned hope for honor... / yet never did I forget my knightly vows. / If I could protect but one person from war's horror... / then I would bear any shame. I would bear it proudly. / I could not defend my home. What is shame to me?

speaker: Ashe; Basch
line_text: My people hate the Empire. They will not accept this. / There is hope.
Hope for a future where we can join hands as brothers. / - Larsa, please. This is serious. - O-Oh, I'm sorry. / Don't be, Larsa. Somebody's got to put him in his place!

speaker: Larsa
line_text: Researchers from the Draklor Laboratory. What were they doing here?

speaker: Balthier
line_text: Research.
